study-path.alt: A study of a school. On the left, a population of 2,400 students drawn as grey dots, a few in plum. An arrow labelled choose leads to a sample of 120 students. An arrow labelled ask leads to the data: each answer is yes or no, and 78 of 120 say yes. A curved arrow returns to the population with the conclusion, in context: about 65% of the school's students say yes.
